item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.2

  • Comprehensive Vietnam Stock Search: Direct integration with VNDirect search API, supporting full coverage across HOSE, HNX, and UPCOM exchanges (including SHS, CEO, MBS, IDC, BSR, and more).
  • Smart Exchange Routing: Automatically identifies Vietnamese equities without requiring .HN or .VN suffixes, routing quotes and chart history to high-precision local data feeds.
  • Watchlist Improvements: Enhanced exchange metadata tracking when adding new assets to watchlists.
